About

Curious by nature.
Careful by design.

Tobie · 冯渝程

I start from how people actually behave, untangle what they need, and give complex systems a shape people can understand and control.

I’m Yucheng Feng, also known as Tobie, studying for an MA in Communication Design at the University of Southampton. My work spans financial tools, creator platforms and physical everyday interactions; I use research, wireframes, component specs and working prototypes to make a decision clear.

User research, interaction design, component systems, physical + digital experiences
